title: Prenatal exposure to PM<sub>2.5</sub> and Congenital Heart Diseases in Taiwan.
authors: Huang CC, Chen BY, Pan SC, Ho YL, Guo YL.
journal: The Science of the total environment
quote: Furthermore, we found that atrial septal defect (aOR = 1.43, 95% CI = 1.01-2.02), endocardial cushion defect (aOR = 2.37, 95% CI = 1.01-5.58), and pulmonary artery and valve stenosis (aOR = 1.71, 95% CI = 1.06-2.78) were significantly associated with PM 2.5 exposures.
